# Read from s3://public-grids/hex/h0-valid.parquet via the duckdb-geo MCP on 2026-09-22.
# `i` is the --h0-index position cng-datasets selects with `WHERE i = <index>`
# (cng_datasets/raster/cog.py:3255); `h0` is the H3 base cell it resolves to.
#
# ⛔ lon_intervals are UNWRAPPED exactly as cog.py:_cell_footprint does: negative longitudes
# +360, and a span > 180 deg means the cell straddles the antimeridian, so its footprint is TWO
# intervals on [-180, 180] separated by ';'. 17 of the 122 cells straddle. Reading ST_XMin/ST_XMax
# off the stored planar polygon instead gives a ~360-deg-wide box that never prunes AND excludes
# the +/-180 strip where the cell's data lives -- wrong in both directions at once.
#
# Latitudes are never wrapped, so the polygon's own lat bounds are used.
# Coordinates are rounded to 5 dp (~1 m); h0_select.py widens boxes outward, never inward.
#
